text.en: A sharp needle pushes into cloth easily but a flat foot does not, even with the same force. Pressure depends on the area as well as the force.

Pressure = force / area; the unit is pascal (Pa), 1 Pa = 1 N/m squared.
Pressure in a liquid at depth h is P = h rho g, where rho is the density; it acts equally in all directions.
Pascal's law: pressure applied to a confined fluid is transmitted equally in all directions; used in hydraulic lifts and brakes.
Atmospheric pressure is about 101 325 Pa and is measured with a barometer.
Buoyant force is the upward force on an object in a fluid; Archimedes principle says it equals the weight of the fluid displaced.
An object floats if its density is less than the liquid's, and sinks if its density is more.
Density = mass / volume, and relative density = density of substance / density of water.

problem.en: A force of 200 N acts on an area of 0.5 square metre. Find the pressure.

prompt.en: State Archimedes principle and Pascal's law.
